package.name: e2e_sim_safety
package.description: L5-flavored end-to-end tests (claude-docs/12-testing.md). Milestone 1's test_sim_safety_e2e.py launches racer_gym_bridge's bridge_node and racer_safety's safety_node together through the REAL command path (/drive_raw -> safety_node -> /drive -> bridge_node, no test-only remaps -- unlike tests/l5_tracker_lap, which needed remaps because no safety_node existed yet), feeds scripted /drive_raw, asserts the sim pose advances, then stops /drive_raw and asserts the watchdog zeroes /drive. Milestone 3's test_sim_autopilot_e2e.py adds racer_control's tracker_node to that same real graph (the classical stack drives the car itself, no scripted /drive_raw), with only a sim-only pose-source adapter remap (tracker_node's own /odom -> bridge_node's /sim/ground_truth_odom). Milestone 5's test_sim_autopilot_e2e_oschersleben.py is a parallel test case against the second committed track (config/tracks/oschersleben), asserting the same progress-with-no-interventions property. This package has no library code of its own -- it exists only to host these integration tests, which need racer_gym_bridge, racer_safety, and (milestone 3) racer_control built and installed together (see .github/scripts/e2e_sim_safety_test.sh).
